patterns.note: Content is predominantly centered horizontally within full-width sections, utilizing generous vertical whitespace to create an airy and minimalist presentation.
The hero and main section headings feature extremely large, elegant serif typography, with specific keywords highlighted in vibrant accent colors to draw attention.
A restrained color palette uses a light background, dark text, and two distinct, contrasting accent colors (orange and purple) for emphasis.
The top navigation bar (MENU, logo, CONTACT) remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Sections are clearly delineated by large vertical spacing and sometimes by a change in background color (e.g., light background transitioning to a solid black section).

technique_notes: The primary navigation is implemented as a sticky header, fixing it to the top of the browser window to ensure constant accessibility as the user scrolls through content.
Large display text achieves emphasis by using a high-contrast serif font and applying distinct accent colors to individual words or short phrases within the main statement.
The overall design relies on a minimalist approach with ample whitespace, centered text, and strong typographic hierarchy to convey sophistication and direct user focus.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body text) with a clean, simple sans-serif for navigation and body text, creating a dramatic contrast.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — very generous vertical spacing between sections and within text blocks, creating a sense of openness and luxury.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and dramatic use of extremely large, elegant serif typography, where key words are highlighted with vibrant accent colors, creating an editorial and high-impact visual statement that feels more like a luxury brand's print ad than a typical website.
